For forty years he had watched ships pass silently into the fog, never speaking a word back; now, for the first time, the sea had delivered a voice directly to his shores.", "w02": "凌晨四点，整座城市沉入最深沉的梦境。高架桥上的路灯连成寂静的橙黄丝带，偶尔有一辆夜班环卫车缓缓驶过，刷洗着冰凉的路面。便利店的白炽灯在薄雾中晕开孤零零的光斑，收银员正低头打着盹。远处摩天大楼的轮廓隐没在青灰色的微光里，白日里的喧嚣尽数散去，只留下夜风穿过空旷街巷的呼吸声，等待着第一缕晨光将其唤醒。", "w03": "- Recursion is when a task solves itself by breaking into a smaller copy of the exact same task.\n- Think of it like opening a Russian nesting doll until you finally reach the tiniest solid doll inside.\n- You must always have a stopping rule, or you will keep unpacking forever."}
